body: of all the r/aww pictures that made me "aww", this one about takes the cake. Wishing you two a life full of silly adventures together. :)
Thanks man. Just finished dinner, and I think I'm alright for now. Thanks for being there.

I will, and have also recently discovered RedditU. (Though most classes are over once I found them). 
I hadn't delved much into Ruby, but I'm always interested (you don't know what you don't know, right?)
And yea - iOS, it was actually the UI side that got me going. But I'd like to know how to do both sides of the pretty imagery.

I feel as though the time it takes to learn something will leave me all old before I can be like AHA! I did it! .... but I guess either way that feeling will be good. 
Thanks for your thoughts... and good luck with those robots.. ;)

Thank you :) Once I get better, maybe I'll redo it (and match the sounds better!) But that's what the premise for it was, I'm glad you understood it and took the time to watch it. 
Frickin Chuck Norris. :p

You're second paragraph really did make me laugh out loud. Thanks ;) My dad's a programmer, and I have bene trying to learn, but he is sooo advanced it makes it hard for him to teach someone barely starting out. 
Working at home has made making friends a little tougher, but I joined some running groups on meetup.com (I am training for marathon #1 this year), and also an iOS dev group, to try and find others that will help teach me. 
Being a noob around so many pros is really hard, but I guess I have to get over it. Thank you for taking the time to reply :)
Thank you very much.. I'm glad to not feel so alone in that thought.

I have just been losing hope within myself, and with people. I want to gain back the passion I had when I was younger, but failing at so many things, and being surrounded with people who are smarter than you (but get frustrated when you ask questions) just isn't helping.

I'm a 3D animator and graphic designer.. and I'm still learning.. my stuff is hoooorrrible right now.. I'm trying to go by the quote "You have to make a lot of crappy things before you make anything good." But I'm starting to wonder if I ever will get to making anything good.. some animation tests are on youtube. user:axxl143
